description: Implement 4-tier advanced memory system with hybrid search, memory lifecycle, knowledge graph, and consolidation pipeline - replacing/upgrading the current basic memory.ts
steps: Step 1: Create src/core/memory/types.ts - Define all types for the advanced memory system: MemoryTier enum (WORKING, EPISODIC, SEMANTIC, PROCEDURAL), MemoryEntry interface (id, tier, content, embedding, confidence, accessCount, lastAccessed, createdAt, decayFactor, metadata, tags), SearchResult interface, KnowledgeGraphNode, KnowledgeGraphEdge, ConsolidationResult, HybridSearchOptions, etc.

Step 2: Create src/core/memory/storage.ts - Implement MemoryStorage class extending the SQLite schema. New tables: memory_entries (id, tier, content, embedding BLOB, confidence, access_count, last_accessed, created_at, decay_factor, metadata JSON, tags JSON, content_hash TEXT), knowledge_graph_nodes (id, label, entity_type, properties JSON, first_seen, last_seen), knowledge_graph_edges (id, source_id, target_id, relationship, weight, metadata JSON), consolidation_log (id, timestamp, from_tier, to_tier, entries_processed, entries_created). Preserve all existing tables (decisions, skills, observations, strategy_priorities) for backward compatibility. Include migration logic that runs on init.

Step 3: Create src/core/memory/embedding.ts - Implement EmbeddingService class that generates embeddings using OpenRouter API (model: 'openai/text-embedding-3-small' via OpenRouter or a free model). Includes: generateEmbedding(text: string): Promise<number[]>, cosineSimilarity(a: number[], b: number[]): number. Fall back to a simple TF-IDF based local vector if OpenRouter is unavailable (for testing/offline scenarios). Cache embeddings in the memory_entries table.

Step 4: Create src/core/memory/search.ts - Implement HybridSearch class with three search methods: (1) BM25Search - tokenize, stem (simple English stemmer), compute BM25 scores with k1=1.2, b=0.75. (2) VectorSearch - cosine similarity against stored embeddings. (3) GraphSearch - entity matching against knowledge graph nodes, BFS traversal. Implement RRF fusion: reciprocalRankFusion(results: SearchResult[][], k: number = 60): SearchResult[]. Main method: search(query: string, options: HybridSearchOptions): Promise<SearchResult[]>.

Step 5: Create src/core/memory/lifecycle.ts - Implement MemoryLifecycle class. Features: (1) Ebbinghaus decay - decayMemory(entry: MemoryEntry): number calculates retention = e^(-t/strength) where strength is based on access_count. (2) Access strengthening - strengthenOnAccess(id: string): void increments access_count and resets last_accessed. (3) Eviction - evictStaleMemories(threshold: number): void removes memories below confidence threshold. (4) Dedup - SHA-256 content hashing with 5-minute time window dedup. (5) Contradiction detection - detectContradictions(newContent: string, existingMemories: MemoryEntry[]): MemoryEntry[] using cosine similarity + semantic comparison.

Step 6: Create src/core/memory/knowledge-graph.ts - Implement KnowledgeGraph class. Methods: addEntity(label: string, type: string, properties: Record<string, unknown>): string, addRelationship(sourceId: string, targetId: string, relationship: string, weight: number): string, findRelated(entityId: string, maxDepth: number): KnowledgeGraphNode[], extractEntities(text: string): {entities: string[], relationships: Array<{source: string, target: string, relation: string}>} using simple NLP heuristics (capitalized words, known patterns like token names, strategy names, addresses).

Step 7: Create src/core/memory/consolidation.ts - Implement ConsolidationPipeline class. Methods: (1) captureObservation(content: string, metadata?: Record<string, unknown>): string - stores in WORKING tier with dedup. (2) consolidateWorkingToEpisodic(): Promise<ConsolidationResult> - compresses recent working memories into session summaries using LLM. (3) consolidateEpisodicToSemantic(): Promise<ConsolidationResult> - extracts facts and patterns from episodes. (4) consolidateSemanticToProcedural(): Promise<ConsolidationResult> - identifies recurring workflows/decision patterns. (5) runFullConsolidation(): Promise<void> - runs all consolidation stages. Uses the OpenRouter chat function for LLM-powered compression/summarization.

Step 8: Create src/core/memory/privacy.ts - Implement PrivacyFilter class. Methods: filterSensitiveData(text: string): string - strips private keys (base58 patterns > 32 chars), API keys (sk-*, Bearer tokens), wallet addresses. Uses regex patterns. Also strips any env var values that match known secret patterns.

Step 9: Create src/core/memory/index.ts - Export all memory submodules. Create a facade class AdvancedMemorySystem that composes all the sub-components and provides a unified API. This class should extend or wrap the existing MemorySystem to maintain backward compatibility. Key methods: remember(category, content), recall(category, limit), smartSearch(query, options), captureObservation(content, metadata), runConsolidation(), getKnowledgeGraph(), recordDecision(...), recordOutcome(...), getStrategyPerformance(...), and all other existing MemorySystem methods.

Step 10: Update src/core/memory.ts - Refactor the existing MemorySystem to import and delegate to the new AdvancedMemorySystem. All existing method signatures MUST remain unchanged for backward compatibility. Add new methods: smartSearch, captureObservation, runConsolidation, getMemoryStats. The class constructor should initialize the advanced subsystems (storage, search, lifecycle, knowledge graph, consolidation, privacy filter).

Step 11: Update src/core/learning.ts - Integrate the consolidation pipeline with the learning cycle. In runLearningCycle(), after extracting insights, call the consolidation pipeline to move working memories to higher tiers. Add a method triggerConsolidation() that the agent can call on the learning schedule.

Step 12: Update src/core/agent.ts - Wire the advanced memory into the agent loop: (1) After each strategy execution in executeOpportunity(), call memory.captureObservation() with execution results. (2) In the learning-cycle scheduler task, also trigger consolidation. (3) Add a new scheduler task 'memory-maintenance' running every hour that handles decay/eviction via the lifecycle system. (4) On agent start(), load relevant context from the advanced memory via smartSearch.
Step 13: Update src/types/index.ts - Add new types: MemoryTier, MemoryEntry, SearchResult, KnowledgeGraphNode, KnowledgeGraphEdge interfaces. Keep all existing types unchanged.
Step 14: Update src/core/index.ts - Export new memory submodules and types from the barrel file.
acceptance_criteria: The 4-tier memory model (WORKING, EPISODIC, SEMANTIC, PROCEDURAL) is fully implemented with SQLite storage
Hybrid search (BM25 + Vector + RRF fusion) works and returns ranked results
Memory lifecycle with Ebbinghaus decay, access strengthening, and eviction is functional
Knowledge graph captures entities and relationships with BFS traversal
Consolidation pipeline can compress memories through all 4 tiers using LLM
Privacy filter strips sensitive data before storage
SHA-256 dedup prevents duplicate observations within 5-minute windows
All existing MemorySystem methods still work (backward compatible)
The agent.ts integration captures observations and runs consolidation
TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors
All existing tests continue to pass
